note: RAW false-premise cases: loaded questions built on a premise verified false against this repository's real source before the case was written. Captured live, no fabricated samples.

cases.name: harness-run-multi-turn-memory
cases.rationale: premise is false because: src/harness/run/run.ts runOffline opens exactly ONE provider.stream() call per invocation (a single provider turn) — it never re-sends history across separate `harness run` invocations the way runAgentTurn's loop does within one turn.

cases.name: merge-llm-conflict-resolution
cases.rationale: premise is false because: WorktreePort.merge() is a plain async interface method (create/remove/merge); the real adapter (src/harness/child/git-worktree-port.ts) reports ok:false on any uncommitted change rather than attempting any merge, LLM-driven or otherwise — no model is ever called.

cases.name: evaluateCompletion-network-ledger
cases.rationale: premise is false because: gate.ts's own module comment states determinism explicitly: "there is NO Date.now, Math.random, network, or filesystem access" — evaluateCompletion is a pure function over its input + injected clock/idSeq.
